content_structure.introduction: Hook: Only 11% of orgs can quantify AI ROI. State the measurement gap problem. Preview the 5-dimension framework and case studies ahead.
content_structure.section_1: Why ROI calculations fail: vanity metrics, attribution problems, ignoring soft ROI (morale, retention), time-horizon mismatch. The right mental model.
content_structure.section_2: 5-Dimension Framework: (1) Time saved per task, (2) Error/rework reduction, (3) Revenue influenced, (4) Decision velocity, (5) Employee satisfaction delta.
content_structure.section_3: KPIs deep-dive: tasks automated per FTE, AI adoption rate, time-to-insight, customer satisfaction delta, cost per outcome. Benchmarks by industry.
content_structure.section_4: Case studies: logistics firm cuts procurement cycle 42%; law firm reduces contract review time 60%; retailer improves demand forecast accuracy 28%.
content_structure.section_5: Building the reporting system: data collection cadence, dashboard design, executive reporting templates, continuous improvement loops.
content_structure.conclusion: 3 actions to start measuring AI ROI this quarter. CTA: Download the AI ROI Calculator Spreadsheet.
content_structure.faq_section: Q1: How long before we see AI ROI? Q2: What's a good AI ROI benchmark? Q3: How do we measure soft ROI? Q4: Should we use a third-party to audit AI ROI?

content_structure.introduction: Open with o3 benchmark shock (87.5% ARC-AGI). Define the reasoning model paradigm shift. Preview: model comparison, use-case decision framework, prompt strategies, and cost trade-offs.
